summary: Iteration 17 — CEO Report → WhatsApp feature verified end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass (auth, agents list, cascade regression, queue+metrics, GET/PUT target, empty-target → 400, send-wa → 200 with fake phone (ok:false as expected), message_log kind='ceo_report' persisted, APScheduler startup logs list all 4 jobs incl daily_ceo_report_wa). Frontend: at 1920x800, ceo-wa-btn is present in right rail, opens ceo-wa-dialog with preloaded target from backend, save persists across reopen, send-wa endpoint is called on click. No regressions.

issues: Canvas2D getImageData warning persists on MatrixRain/Constellation (perf-only, no functional impact — carried over from iter 15/16).

critical_code_review_comments: Copilot.jsx disables ceo-wa-send when target is empty, so the review-request bullet 'empty target shows an error toast' is enforced by disabled button (request never fires — arguably better UX than a toast). Acceptable.

scheduler.daily_ceo_report_wa calls ceo_report_send_wa() which raises HTTPException(400) when no target is configured — the wrapper catches Exception generically so the 08:15 cron will silently no-op. OK but a specific catch on HTTPException with an info-level log would be cleaner.
routes/agents.py — _format_ceo_message hard-codes emoji + Spanish copy; consider extracting to a template if the tone needs A/B testing later.
message_log insert uses `id = iso + '-ceo'` which is not unique when two sends land in the same second → possible DuplicateKeyError if a unique index is later added. Consider uuid4().
test_credentials: qa2@litper.co / Litper!2026 (cookie JWT); Chatea Pro configured server-side; test WA target +573001112222 (Chatea returns ok:false — expected).
seed_data_creation: None. Tests reset db.settings.ceo_report_wa_target between assertions by PUT '' then PUT '+573001112222'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 17 CEO-WA feature is live and green. New endpoints: GET/PUT /api/agents/ceo-report/target, POST /api/agents/ceo-report/send-wa. New scheduler job: daily_ceo_report_wa (cron 13:15 UTC = 08:15 Bogotá). Frontend testids: ceo-wa-btn, ceo-wa-dialog, ceo-wa-target, ceo-wa-save, ceo-wa-send. Send-wa returns HTTP 200 with ok:false for the fake phone — that is the correct behavior; do not flag as bug.
